Abstract

At least selectively utilizing a large language model (LLM) in generating a natural language (NL) based summary to be rendered in response to a query.

Description

BACKGROUND
Various generative models have been proposed.

Claims (3)

What is claimed is:
1. A method implemented by one or more processors, the method comprising:
receiving a query associated with a client device;
selecting search result documents based on a selection rate.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the interaction includes viewing.
3. A system comprising one or more processors configured to perform the method.
